answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a signal as the anchor of the cost.
